messages:
Maya: Thanks for coming to todays all-hands. Opening a short follow-up for the questions we ran out of time on around model catalog curation and deprecation. Recording + slides: https://redwood.ai/allhands/jun-2026 :sparkles:
Ethan: Two quick asks from partners: 1) How do we qualify third-party models for the catalog? 2) What's the deprecation notice period when we remove a model? Need specifics for contracts.
Maya: Good q. High level: we audit license + perf + reproducibility. Deprecation: default notice 90 days + migration guide. Will confirm legal details. Owner for the policy doc: @Ben.
Rina: For third-party onboarding, can we define minimal eval bar and required tests (latency, mem, generation safety)? I can draft a checklist.
Oliver: Also need a metric for "maintenance risk" (how often maintainers publish fixes). If it's high risk we mark as community-unsupported. Owner: @Oliver will prototype a risk scorecard.
Ben: I'll run the deprecation SLA check with legal. Target: draft policy by Wed. Will include contract language and exceptions for security patches.
Ethan: Product ask: show catalog provenance in the UI (model source, owners, last-updated, recommended quant profiles). That helps sales + SRE. Owner: @Rina for content + @Oliver for UI fields.
Rina: I'll make a simple doc and CSV schema for the metadata fields. ETA: EOW.
Maya: Decision: 90-day default deprecation + emergency-security exemptions. Ben to confirm legal text. Rina to produce metadata schema. Oliver to prototype risk scorecard.
product-bot: Reminder: issue template for model-onboarding was updated in #product at 2026-06-10T11:22:00Z.
Oliver: I'll add a sample risk calculation to the repo and include an example: low/medium/high with 3 signals (update frequency, open issues, maintainer activity).
Ethan: Can we add a small migration tool that maps requests from deprecated model -> recommended replacement? Even a doc would help. Owner: @Ethan (will pair with SDK).
Maya: Compact actions:
- @Ben: legal + deprecation notice text (Wed)
- @Rina: catalog metadata schema + onboarding checklist (EOW)
- @Oliver: risk scorecard prototype + UI field list (next Tue)
- @Ethan: migration mapping doc/tool (proto by next sprint)
Ill consolidate into a short policy doc and post to the handbook. If you take an item please @mention me so I can update owners. Thanks!
